L<3n is closed by the already-proved d_min<=2 reroot into the previous finite frontier
proof_method.polarity_coverage: Every p+q=d split is covered; p<->q symmetry is used only to halve duplicate cases.
proof_method.normalization_overapprox: After exact elimination, canonicalization and unit propagation can only reduce n,m,L. The verifier therefore materializes every unit-free integer state below the proved output m/L caps. This is an overapproximation: every actual state is represented, while extra impossible states may also be checked.
proof_method.induction: States whose local input size 1+n+m+L is at most the already-proved previous frontier are discharged by strong induction; the current N^2 cap is no smaller than the inherited local cap.
proof_method.acyclicity: Every ordinary elimination removes its pivot, so n strictly decreases and the finite abstract graph is processed in descending n layers.
